description: This file defines a React Native functional component called NotesListScreen, which displays a list of notes with search, refresh, and navigation functionalities. It imports various components and theme constants, and manages local state for notes, query, and refresh status.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches all notes using listNotes and updates state; called on mount and during refresh.

methods.name: onRefresh
methods.description: Handles pull-to-refresh action by toggling refreshing state, reloading notes, then resetting the state.
